title: Polynomial-time sparse model search by bounded elimination replay
claims: MeasuredReverseClause reverses the sequence of canonical encoded literals in polynomial time.
MeasuredEliminationWitness returns a verified sparse satisfying assignment or the empty word exactly on unsatisfiable inputs under supplied stage coverage and a complete variable order.
MeasuredWidthEliminationWitness generates the fixed-width universe automatically and implements the same exact search for complete orders with bounded intermediate clause cardinality.

experiments.purpose: Bind all archived Lean overlay sources and the recorded exact statements to the local reference replay. The isolated experiment reports its live Lean invocation count, which may be zero.
